title: Zoho Analytics 7.0: Ask Zia Gets 6 AI Agents and a Claude Connector
headline: Analytics gets *six AI agents*
source_line: Sources: Zoho Analytics What's New; Zoho press release 10 Nov 2026 (checked 18 Nov 2026)

sources.name: Zoho press release 10 Nov 2026 via Vietnam Investment Review

description:
Zoho Analytics 7.0 adds Ask Zia, a super agent that routes your question to six specialist agents (data analysis, visualization, data prep, formula, SQL and coding). Zoho also released an Analytics MCP server, a command line interface, and a connector for Claude Desktop (macOS and Windows). Pricing is unchanged and Zoho LLM credits are now included in each plan; cloud updates are available now, on-premise follows in Q1 2027.

Sources (checked 18 Nov 2026):
- Zoho Analytics - What's new: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/whats-new.html
- Zoho press release (10 Nov 2026) via Vietnam Investment Review: https://vir.com.vn/zoho-upgrades-analytics-platform-with-agentic-artificial-intelligence-capabilities-164929.html
- Zoho Analytics MCP Server: https://www.zoho.com/analytics/api/v2/zoho-analytics-mcp-server.html

This video uses an AI-generated presenter, voice and animations; facts were checked against the sources above.

lines: Ask Zia is the super agent. It takes your question and routes it to the right specialist.
Those specialists cover data analysis, visualization, data prep, formulas, SQL and coding.
Zoho also released an Analytics MCP server and a command line tool.
And there is a connector for Claude Desktop on Mac and Windows.
